metadata.name: DELLA ZIP Climate Dataset
metadata.record_format: zip -> '<IECC zone code>:<climate type code>'; resolve temps via legend.zones, type via legend.types
sources: DOE/PNNL Building America county climate assignments (climate_zones.csv)
US Census 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file; dominant county by land overlap
metadata.design_temp_provenance: DELLA Engine V1 policy approximations by IECC zone+moisture; not ASHRAE station data. Engine climate margins (+3F summer / -5F winter) account for this coarseness.
metadata.fallback_rule: exact zip -> prefix3 majority -> null (manual region selection, PRD 14.5)
